about: M0's cost revisit: run 3's 13-step tick on the plan's script under solver variants, in Chromium at 4x throttle (scripts/revisit/cost.mjs)
name: variants

method.page: ?test=cost on the production build (dist/), served by e2e/serve.mjs with COOP and COEP

modes.drawn: one unit of work per 60 Hz tick while the scene draws

method.order: a fresh Chromium per repetition; every variant per repetition, its order rotated by one each repetition; each variant: desktop then Pixel 8a, drawn then back to back
method.loadGate: before each run, the 1-minute load average at most 4, rechecked every 15 s for up to 20 minutes
